meta.title: I Stayed at a 5-Star Hotel in Da Nang… Is It Actually Worth It?
meta.description:
Stay Connected https://www.instagram.com/losterah
This is why I LOVE Saigon - https://youtu.be/150-Q18Ji5Y
I stayed at the TMS hotel, a 5-star beachfront hotel in Da Nang, Vietnam, to see if the luxury actually lives up to the label.

In this video, I’m breaking down what a 5-star hotel experience looks like in Vietnam — from the ocean-view room and infinity pool to the location, amenities, and real nightly cost.

Da Nang is quickly becoming one of the best travel destinations in Vietnam, especially if you’re looking for luxury hotels that don’t cost what they would back home in the US, Canada, or Europe.

I’ll show you exactly what you get for the price, the pros and cons of staying here, and whether this hotel is actually worth it if you’re planning a trip to Vietnam.

If you’re researching where to stay in Da Nang, looking for the best beachfront hotels in Vietnam, or curious how far your money goes in Southeast Asia — this video will give you a real, honest look.

📍 Location: Da Nang, Vietnam
🏨 Hotel: TMS Hotel Da Nang Beach
